Links
=====
You can find more details on each library used in the Orange County Lettings application by checking the links below :

* `Django <https://www.djangoproject.com/>`_

* `WhiteNoise <https://whitenoise.readthedocs.io/en/stable/django.html>`_

* `Flake8 <https://flake8.pycqa.org/en/latest/>`_

* `Flake8-html <https://pypi.org/project/flake8-html/>`_

* `Pytest <https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/>`_

* `Pytest-cov <https://pypi.org/project/pytest-cov/>`_

* `Pytest-django <https://pytest-django.readthedocs.io/en/latest/>`_

* `Sentry-sdk <https://pypi.org/project/sentry-sdk/>`_

* `Docker <https://docs.docker.com/>`_

* `Heroku with Docker <https://devcenter.heroku.com/categories/deploying-with-docker>`_
